description: Aggregate invoices or vouchers over a date range WITHOUT returning rows: counts plus net/tax/gross sums, grouped by month, status, contact or nothing. Use this for totals ('revenue in Q2', 'expenses by supplier') instead of the list tools — the response stays small however large the ledger is. Read-only.

maxGroups.description: Cap on returned groups; the remainder is folded into one '(andere)' entry (default 40).

maxItems.description: Fetch cap: how many records are read from sevDesk before filtering (default 10000).

side.description: Vouchers only: expense (money out), revenue (money in) or any (default).

name: sevdesk_summarize
title: Summarize invoices or vouchers (totals, not rows)
